series.name: Fixya forum user reports (F9, E0)
series.notes: Fixya threads: F9 on SGSi188-i5, E0/E9 user reports. Low-medium (single forum each); conflicts with other E0 meanings noted.

meaning.en: Answer states F9 usually points to a malfunctioning indoor fan motor, though it notes meanings vary by model.
meaning.ur: Jawab ke mutabiq F9 aam tor par kharab indoor fan motor ki taraf ishara karta hai, halanke model ke hisaab se matlab badalta hai.

causes.en: Damaged wiring to the fan or control board issue
causes.ur: Fan ya control board ki wiring kharab, ya board mein masla

solutions.en: Power off; check the indoor fan blades for obstructions
solutions.ur: Pehle unit ki power band karein, phir indoor fan ke paron mein koi rukawat to nahi ye check karein

solutions.en: Inspect fan wiring; reset; call a pro if it persists
solutions.ur: Fan ki wiring check karein, unit reset karein, masla qaim rahe to professional ko bulayein

source.title: Fixya — 'My super general AC show me F9 error code'

notes.en: Single generic forum answer, no model given. Persian-labelled SG table says F9 = outdoor EEPROM (direct conflict → do not merge).
notes.ur: Sirf ek generic forum jawab hai, model nahi bataya. Persian-labelled SG table kehti hai F9 = outdoor EEPROM (seedha conflict → milayein nahi).

title.ur: User ki report: inverter fault (matlab wazeh nahi)

meaning.en: A user asked what E0 means on their Super General inverter AC; no trustworthy brand-specific answer was given in the thread.
meaning.ur: Ek user ne apne Super General inverter AC par E0 ka matlab poocha; thread mein brand ka koi bharosemand jawab nahi mila.

causes.en: EEPROM data on the control board lost or corrupted during a power disturbance
causes.ur: Bijli ki gadbad ke dauran control board ka EEPROM data kho ya kharab ho jana

causes.en: Loose supply connection or weak mains making the startup self-check fail
causes.ur: Dheela supply connection ya kamzor bijli jis se startup ka self-check fail ho jata hai

solutions.en: Turn the AC off at the breaker and wait about five minutes so the board can reset, then switch it on once.
solutions.ur: AC ko breaker se band kar ke kareeb 5 minute rukein taake board reset ho sake, phir ek baar on karein.

solutions.en: If E0 comes back, write down the exact display and check the model number in the manual, then treat it as the §5.1 E0 meaning (EEPROM / general self-diagnostic) until the manual confirms it.
solutions.ur: Agar E0 wapas aaye to display par likha code note karein aur manual mein model number check karein, phir manual confirm karne tak isay §5.1 wale E0 ke matlab (EEPROM / aam general self-diagnostic kharabi) mein maan lein.

solutions.en: Do not open the board yourself; ask a technician to read the control-board and EEPROM status.
solutions.ur: Khud board na kholein; technician se control board aur EEPROM ki reading check karwayein.

source.title: Fixya — 'Super general inverter AC error code E0'

notes.en: Thread answers cited Bosch/Fujitsu material (quarantined). Entry kept only as evidence the code appears on SG inverters; canonical meaning from §5.1.
notes.ur: Thread ke jawabon mein Bosch/Fujitsu material zikr tha (quarantine kar diya). Entry sirf is gawahi ke liye rakhi hai ke yeh code SG inverters par aata hai; asal matlab §5.1 se liya hai.
